WITH patient_averages AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) as patient_acl_igg,
    AVG(e.ANA) as patient_ana
  FROM Patient p
  INNER JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
  GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
),
sex_aggregates AS (
  SELECT
    SEX,
    AVG(patient_acl_igg) as sex_avg_acl_igg,
    AVG(patient_ana) as sex_avg_ana
  FROM patient_averages
  GROUP BY SEX
),
global_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(sex_avg_ana) as global_mean_ana
  FROM sex_aggregates
)
SELECT
  s.SEX,
  s.sex_avg_acl_igg,
  s.sex_avg_ana,
  s.sex_avg_ana / g.global_mean_ana
FROM sex_aggregates s
CROSS JOIN global_stats g
ORDER BY s.SEX
